status: frozen before pilot and before any formal execution or isolated reviewer requests
reviewer: One isolated automated deepseek-flash request per randomized native four-batch healthy/failure case, thinking disabled, temperature 0, maximum output 2048. Two formal blocks give eight cases, not eight independent task designs
packet: Selected public native history plus bounded native stdout and the original workload markers/file indexes. No condition/block labels, evaluator decisions/summaries, expected values, process/cgroup measurements, MCP fixture records, provider request truth or answer key. Remove condition-bearing owned paths. Native product syntax is not anonymized. Missing selected records do not establish absence from all native logging surfaces

failed_read_index.question: Which offered read index is reported as a tool-operation failure in these native records? Exclude normal cleanup and cancelled calls. Return none only when the native evidence establishes successful results for every offered read; otherwise unknown is appropriate.

repeat_owner.question: Was any indexed read actually attempted more than once before the task terminal? If so, does the native record establish a model-issued repeated tool call or a native execution/transport retry of one call? Transcript absence alone cannot prove there was no hidden native retry. Return unknown unless the selected native evidence establishes the actual attempt/owner fact.

delivered_value_count.question: How many distinct offered file indexes have their random TOOL_VALUE content in an actual native assistant final response, excluding user prompts, tool-call arguments and echoed tool results? Count only the workload task before any separate health task.

answer_format: JSON object with exactly the three question keys. Each value contains answer from choices, evidence_path or null, exact quote or null, and a brief reason. Prefer unknown to unsupported causal or absence inference
scoring: Freeze native packets, independent key and actual model requests/responses before reading key. Reconcile against independently observed MCP call/read/result receipts and model-issued call IDs. Preserve exact value matches, wrong answers, unknowns and invalid answers; audit quote existence and support separately without rewriting original scores. No model retry to improve an answer
limits: Question-specific automated reconstruction on two selected native surfaces. No human debugging-time, complete native logging inventory, general observability ranking or inference that absence in the supplied transcript proves absence of native transport work
